title: Yahooɓe e ladde Verdant
intro: E jamaanu ɓooyɗo, yimɓe ɗiɗo ina njiyloo leyɗeele hoɗdiiɓe. Laawol maɓɓe ina njiidi, kono ɓerɗe maɓɓe ina njahda e nokkuuji ceertuɗi no feewi. Gooto yahri laawol peewal, goɗɗo oo majjii e niɓɓere yeddude. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sirlu ɓeeɗoo ɗiɗo reennooɓe kosam?
clues: Miɗo joginoo gese keewɗe, gese ɓutte ɗe gite ƴeewooɓe njiylotonoo.
Koɗo am ina joginoo jawdi ɓurndi mi, kono miɗo yiɗi geɗal maɓɓe ɓurngal am.
Miɗo wasiyoo nde min mbonnata gese maɓɓe haa laaɓa cer, ngam tiiɗtinde kala ko woni e les njiimaandi am.
Mi addii bonnugol e dow kosam am kadi, mi halkii kala ko woni e peeje am majjere.
Mi dariima mi alaa ballal nde gese am yoori, jawdi am wayliima wonti ɓuuɓri e nder jamma gooto.
Mi alaa geɗal e laakara, hoɗorde am sakkitiinde wonti ɓuuɓol yiite ɓuuɓɗo.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Joom leydi alɗuɗo mo ŋakkaani yettoore
Remoowo mo yiɗi leydi hoɗdiiɓe mum en
identity.answer: Remoowo mo yiɗi leydi hoɗdiiɓe mum en

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Halkere timmunde ndema ɗiɗi ɗee fof e nder nguurndam ɗam
Jawdi wakkati rewi heen ko yiite duumotooɗo
Restoraasiyoŋ kaawis e moƴƴere laabi ɗiɗi
outcome.answer: Halkere timmunde ndema ɗiɗi ɗee fof e nder nguurndam ɗam

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
